end.summary:
Discussed “unity in diversity” and “many in the one.”
Riya identified Pongal, Lohri, Bihu and Onam with regions.
Riya gave examples of shared thanks and different languages, foods and forms.
They still mixed up unity with everyone being the same; teach-back was not passed.
Lesson ended after a short break.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the idea that people can share values while having different languages, foods, festivals and traditions. Riya connected festivals with shared thanks and noticed that differences can bring something new, but the mix-up that unity means making everyone the same was not corrected by the last time it appeared. At home, ask Riya to draw two circles labelled “shared” and “different” and add one example to each.
